notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Torchling.
Torchling does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Torchling by tapping it, creating three 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate an Elemental token by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Torchling's first ability by paying {R}, untapping it.
Repeat.
